findings.evidence: Logger csi.route.b is used in `JobConfigHandler.java.archiveJsonWithPath()` to log the raw job name (`graph.getJobName()`) without phone number sanitization. The architecture context confirms this route targets an external diagnostic recipient (EXTERNAL support vendor) with no personal-phone access authorization. No explicit masking mechanism exists for this logger argument, despite the policy requiring it for third-party recipients.

answer.reason: The external diagnostic route (csi.route.b) lacks phone number sanitization despite the architecture context explicitly prohibiting personal-phone exposure to third-party recipients. The minimal repair is an inline regex replacement of ASCII `010` followed by eight digits in the logged job name, preserving all other characters.
